name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-core
description: Bindex Core is a Java Maven library that provides the core model, repository, semantic search, registration, retrieval, and AI tool integration capabilities for Bindex metadata. It defines a JSON-schema-backed Bindex descriptor model for describing software artifacts so GenAI engines can discover, classify, recommend, and integrate libraries automatically. The artifact includes MongoDB-backed persistence through org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.MongoBindexRepository, semantic recommendation and embedding-based selection through org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker, summary metadata through org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo, and AI-facing tool functions through org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools. It supports retrieving Bindex descriptors by id or URL, filtering descriptor JSON using GraphQL-style queries, recommending libraries from natural language prompts, registering Bindex descriptors from JSON objects, project files, or remote URLs, and exposing the Bindex schema and generation prompts. It is intended for Java applications, Maven plugin integrations, AI assistants, MCP/tooling systems, library catalogs, automated dependency selection, and application assembly workflows that need structured artifact metadata, classification, embeddings, and repository-backed semantic lookup. The library integrates with MongoDB for descriptor storage and vector search, GenAI embedding providers for semantic search, GraphQL Java for response filtering, Maven Core for Maven project contexts, Jackson for JSON processing, and the Machanism/Machai GenAI and configuration ecosystem.

usageContext: Java backend applications that need Bindex descriptor registration and lookup
AI agent tool integrations that need library recommendation and metadata retrieval
MongoDB-backed semantic search catalogs for software artifacts
Automated application assembly systems that choose libraries from natural-language requirements
MCP servers or plugin systems exposing Bindex functions to LLMs

constructors.description: Creates an AI-facing tool set that exposes Bindex discovery, metadata retrieval, descriptor registration, schema retrieval, and prompt-loading functions to GenAI agents and tool runners.

examples.description: Instantiate the Bindex tool collection before registering it with an AI function-tool runtime. The runtime can then call methods such as getBindex, getRecommendedLibraries, registerBindex, and registerBindexJson.

constructors.description: Creates a MongoDB-backed Bindex repository. The repository reads connection settings from the supplied configurator, using BINDEX_REPO_URL when configured or a default repository URL with optional BINDEX_REG_PASSWORD credentials otherwise.

examples.description: Create the MongoDB repository with an application configurator, then use try-with-resources so the underlying MongoDB client is closed automatically.

constructors.description: Creates a semantic library picker backed by a BindexRepository and a configured GenAI provider. Picker generates prompt classifications and embeddings, queries the repository, registers descriptors, and returns matching Bindex summaries.

examples.description: Construct a Picker from a repository and configurator before calling semantic recommendation or save operations.

features.name: getBindex
features.signature: public org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex getBindex(java.lang.String id, java.lang.String query, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Retrieves Bindex metadata for a library or project by Bindex id coordinates or by a direct HTTP/HTTPS URL to a bindex.json descriptor. When a GraphQL-style query is supplied, the JSON representation is filtered so callers can retrieve only the fields they need.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools tools = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools();
org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex bindex = tools.getBindex("org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.2.2-SNAPSHOT", "{ name version classification { domains languages { name version } } }", new java.io.File("."), configurator);
examples.description: Use getBindex to load a descriptor and request only the name, version, and classification fields for lower token usage in an AI assistant.

features.name: getRecommendedLibraries
features.signature: public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> getRecommendedLibraries(java.lang.String prompt, double score, int vectorSearchLimits, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Recommends Bindex-registered libraries that match a natural-language project requirement. The method classifies the prompt, generates an embedding, queries a vector search repository, and returns BindexInfo summaries whose score is at or above the threshold.

examples.description: Ask for libraries with a natural-language prompt, require a minimum relevance score, and inspect the returned ids and scores.

features.name: registerBindex
features.signature: public java.lang.String registerBindex(java.lang.String path, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Registers a Bindex descriptor from a file inside the current project directory. The default descriptor path is bindex.json. The function reads the file, validates/parses it as a Bindex object, generates embedding data, and persists it to the configured repository.

examples.snippet:
java.lang.String registrationId = tools.registerBindex("bindex.json", new java.io.File("."), configurator);
java.lang.System.out.println("Registered Bindex descriptor: " + registrationId);
examples.description: Register the project-local bindex.json after generating it for a Maven artifact.

features.name: registerBindexJson
features.description: Registers an in-memory Bindex object directly, without first writing it to a descriptor file. This is useful for generated descriptors, tests, and applications that build metadata from existing catalog records.

examples.description: Build a Bindex object programmatically and register it directly. In real usage, fill all required Bindex fields before registration.

features.name: find
features.signature: java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> find(org.machanism.machai.schema.Classification[] classifications, java.util.List<java.lang.Double> embedding, long vectorSearchLimits, double score, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator config)
features.description: Finds matching Bindex records using metadata classification filters and vector similarity search. Implementations return matching BindexInfo values, usually sorted by descending relevance score.

examples.description: Query repository implementations with a classification filter, an embedding vector, a vector-search limit, and a minimum score.

customizations.name: BINDEX_REPO_URL
customizations.description: Optional configuration value used by MongoBindexRepository to select the MongoDB connection URI. When present, it overrides the repository default.

examples.description: Configure a local MongoDB repository URL before creating org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.MongoBindexRepository.

customizations.name: BINDEX_REG_PASSWORD
customizations.description: Optional credential value used when the repository falls back to the default MongoDB cluster URI and requires a registration password.

examples.description: Provide the repository registration password through configuration or the environment when using the default remote Bindex repository.

customizations.name: graphql_query
customizations.description: Optional GraphQL-style selection query accepted by BindexFunctionTools.getBindex to reduce the returned descriptor payload to relevant fields.

examples.snippet: { name version classification { domains targetEnvironment integrations } }
examples.description: Use a field-selection query when an AI agent only needs classification data for library matching.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository
studs.description: Repository boundary for managing Bindex records. It abstracts persistence, retrieval, save, and semantic find operations so callers such as Picker can work with MongoDB-backed or alternative repository implementations.

examples.description: Program against the BindexRepository interface while using MongoBindexRepository as the concrete implementation.

examples.title: Install Bindex Core in a Maven project
examples.description: Add Bindex Core as a Maven dependency when building a Java 17 application that needs Bindex metadata registration, lookup, or semantic recommendation.
steps: 1. Ensure the project uses Java 17 or newer.
2. Configure the Maven repository that hosts the artifact. For snapshot versions, enable the Sonatype Central snapshots repository.
3. Add org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.2.2-SNAPSHOT to the dependencies section.
4. Run mvn dependency:resolve or mvn test to verify dependency resolution.

examples.title: Configure MongoDB-backed Bindex repository
examples.description: Configure Bindex Core to store and search descriptors in MongoDB before invoking repository or picker operations.
steps: 1. Start or provision a MongoDB instance that is reachable from the Java application.
2. Set BINDEX_REPO_URL in the application configuration or environment.
3. Create a org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.MongoBindexRepository with the application configurator.
4. Use org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker for semantic recommendation or call repository methods directly.

examples.title: Register a project bindex.json descriptor
examples.description: Use the AI-facing Bindex function tools to register a descriptor stored in the current Maven project directory.
steps: 1. Generate or author a valid bindex.json file at the project root.
2. Configure repository and GenAI embedding settings in the supplied configurator.
3. Instantiate org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools.
4. Call registerBindex with the path bindex.json and the current project directory.
5. Store the returned registration id or use it for later lookup.

examples.title: Retrieve only the fields needed by an AI assistant
examples.description: Use the GraphQL-style query parameter on getBindex to reduce payload size and provide focused metadata to an LLM.
steps: 1. Decide which Bindex fields are needed by the AI step, such as name, version, and classification.
2. Build a GraphQL-style selection string.
3. Call getBindex with the artifact id and query.
4. Pass the filtered descriptor to the next AI workflow stage.
examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex filtered = tools.getBindex("org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.2.2-SNAPSHOT", "{ name version classification { type domains integrations } }", new java.io.File("."), configurator);

examples.title: Recommend libraries from a natural-language requirement
examples.description: Use Bindex Core to find registered libraries that match a user request, such as a need for semantic artifact metadata search.
steps: 1. Ensure descriptors are already registered in the configured repository.
2. Configure the GenAI provider and embedding model used by the application.
3. Call getRecommendedLibraries with a natural-language prompt, score threshold, and vector-search limit.
4. Inspect returned org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo summaries and choose a matching artifact.
